notes: Babosa::Identifier.new(text).transliterate.to_s with defaults; Latin only, so Cyrillic and Greek come back unchanged and the check fails.
details: With no arguments, transliterate uses only the Latin transliterator. The other scripts are separate (transliterate(:cyrillic), :greek), so Cyrillic and Greek letters pass through untouched and fixture 0 fails. The variant babosa-all-scripts passes the three scripts.
